_comment: STUBBED comparables. In production comparables.lookup() queries the carrier's historical claims corpus: 'find claims with a similar damage pattern on a similar vehicle, and report what the repair actually involved after teardown', returning observed rates like '38% of 340 comparable claims involved radiator support damage'. That corpus exists only inside a carrier. Here it is a hand-written rules table with no observed rates, because inventing rates would be fabricating evidence. The interface is final; only the body of lookup() changes.
_why_this_matters: A Tractable executive said in 2024 he had not seen an AI tool reduce supplement amounts, because AI assesses damage visually, before teardown. Pre-teardown blindness is the hard information limit in this domain. This component does not remove it — it uses history to say what is usually behind the panel.

front_bumper.rationale: Front impacts of this type frequently deform the support behind the bumper reinforcement.
Brackets commonly crack even where the lamp lens itself is undamaged.
Sits behind the cover and is not visible until the cover is removed.
Mounted in the front corner cavity on many platforms.

front_grille.rationale: Grille damage often accompanies cooling stack contact.
Forward radar mounts behind the grille and may be displaced without visible damage.

hood.rationale: Hinge distortion is common and only apparent on alignment check.

rear_bumper.rationale: Rear impacts transmit load through the bumper bar into the floor pan.
Harness runs along the inside face of the bumper cover.

left_quarter_panel.rationale: Quarter panel damage routinely extends to the inner structure.
Positioned inside the quarter on most platforms.

right_quarter_panel.rationale: Quarter panel damage routinely extends to the inner structure.

left_front_door.rationale: Internal beam absorbs side impact and is not visible externally.
Runs through the hinge pillar boot and is commonly pinched.

right_front_door.rationale: Internal beam absorbs side impact and is not visible externally.
Runs through the hinge pillar boot and is commonly pinched.

left_front_fender.rationale: Torn liners are routine and hidden behind the outer panel.
Deformation visible only once the panel is removed.

right_front_fender.rationale: Torn liners are routine and hidden behind the outer panel.
Deformation visible only once the panel is removed.

left_front_wheel.rationale: A strike hard enough to gouge the outer lip can bend or crack the inboard flange, which is not visible with the wheel fitted.
The inner sidewall takes the pinch against the rim and cannot be inspected until the tire is dismounted.
Curb impacts commonly disturb camber and toe. Only a rack measurement settles it.
Mounted to the rim at the valve and damaged by impacts in that area.
